_comment: Scav runs (DESIGN.md §2, §4.1, §5.1, §16.3), read by ScavRuns and checked when it loads (ScavRuns.problems()). start: a Scav run joins a raid already under way, at a random share of the raid time in window (maps: a window per map id, else the default), never leaving less than min_left_seconds on the clock; a Run Through on a Scav run is extracting sooner than raid.tres run_through_seconds or run_through_share of the time that was left when you joined, whichever is shorter (and with less experience than run_through_xp). fast_forward: what the raid did before you joined. squad_spacing: the AI PMC squads already in the raid start at least this many metres apart, or squad_spacing_unseen with a wall between them (where the map has the room; a squad that can only start in a clear line closer than squad_spacing to a squad of the other faction already fought it, and lies dead). loot_taken: the share of loose loot and container contents already gone, per_raid times the share of the raid that has passed (an event crate: since it turned up), at most max; pmc_deaths: an AI PMC's chance of lying dead somewhere, per whole raid it has been in it (its body at a point of interest with its kit). cooldown_minutes: real minutes from deploying as a Scav until the next Scav run (times the Intelligence Center's multiplier and the kit tier's cooldown). karma: Mole's standing, range [lowest, highest], starting at start; the change for killing a friendly AI Scav (friendly_kill), a guard (guard_kill) or a boss (boss_kill) as a Scav (one that hadn't attacked you before you attacked it), killing any PMC as a Scav (pmc_kill), extracting with others (extract_with_others, once a raid: a friendly AI Scav within with_others_radius metres as you extract, or one that left through the same extract in the last with_others_seconds) and any Scav extract (extract). A Scav counts as friendly when you first attack it if it hadn't attacked you and wasn't hostile to you for your karma alone; one that dies of wounds you gave it (you hurt it last) counts as your kill. Below hostile_below AI Scavs shoot your Scav on sight; their reaction time is multiplied by reaction[0] just below it (at most 2: slower, and one that sees you for a second ducks into cover before it fires), falling in a straight line to reaction[1] at the lowest karma; if the raid's karma climbs back to hostile_below, those hostile to you for it alone let you be. kit_tiers: the player's Scav kit by karma, worst first: a tier with at_most is the kit at karma at or below it (the lowest that matches), one with at_least at or above it (the highest that matches), the one with neither the rest; overrides change data/bots/scav_kit.tres (BotKit.with_tier(): rarity multipliers on every gear roll Common to Legendary, the armor, helmet, backpack, melee, bandage and medkit chances, medkit_rarity, gun_durability, pocket_items, armored_rigs: false for no armored rig), and cooldown multiplies the Scav cooldown.
